w.e: OE. ymel, imelle, of Scand. origin; cf. Icel. i milli, i millum (properly, in the middle, fr. mi, me, middle, akin to E. middle), Dan. imellem, Sw. emellan. See In, and Middle.

n: (Norse mythology) the primeval giant slain by Odin and his brothers and from whose body they created the world: the sea from his blood
